verdict.why: The LEFT build reads as one coherent brick cottage with a clean teal-and-terracotta roof, consistent stone base, regular window and door bays, and a chimney that anchors the silhouette, whereas the RIGHT build's walls are ragged with missing sections, stair-stepped and mismatched roof cladding, and blocky dark-stone trim that looks scattered rather than designed, even though its interior and torch-lit doorway show more ambition.
